summary.intent: Complete and verify phase 66 (api-schema-cutover-publish-gate-and-tombstone) of the CipherBox project, ensuring all 9 implementation plans and 7 requirement IDs were satisfied before advancing to phase 67.
summary.outcome: Phase 66 was successfully verified (6/6 must-haves, all 7 requirement IDs confirmed via static analysis) and finalized via `phase.complete`, with completion artifacts committed and todos closed.

repo: Phase 66 schema changes: share_keys table deleted; shares table gained read_descriptor_ref, write_descriptor_ref, root_node_id, root_ipns_name, root_generation columns with @Unique(['sharerId','recipientId','rootNodeId'])
folder_ipns entity renamed to ipns_records (IpnsRecord class); publicKey field dropped in favor of publicKeyFromIpnsName recovery; tombstoned_at and generation columns added
Atomic CAS publish uses a 4-predicate WHERE on ipns_name, sequence_number, generation, and tombstoned_at IS NULL; result.affected === 0 drives disambiguation
parseCachedRecord returns { seqFloor } on null signedRecord; resolveRecord type-narrows on discriminant and fails closed when networkSeq < seqFloor
Tombstone returns HTTP 410 GONE; authz via user_id predicate; unenrollIpns called on tombstone
Both sdk-core publish primitives (cas.ts, ipns/index.ts) forward optional generation field to API
Generated openapi.json includes /ipns/tombstone path, generation in publish schema, and 410 IPNS_TOMBSTONED on publish and resolve; generated shares client has zero references to deleted operations
